subject: Pricing conversation: per-token commit options for EdgeAI
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir@edgeai.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@edgeai.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API pricing — large monthly token commit

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency and cost tooling. We ran a model-level forecast and expect to put substantial hosted API volume through Redwood next year. High-level numbers:
- Expected steady-state: ~60–90B tokens/month by Q4 (peaks to 120B)
- Growth: +60% YoY
- Strict data residency: US regions only

We want to understand whether you can offer a custom per-token commit rate (not just the public rate card). Specifically:
1) Example pricing for a committed 12–24 month tier at ~75B tokens/mo
2) Overage mechanics and whether prefix/KV caching credits apply
3) Any minimums, SFDC/marketplace implications, and required commercial approvals

We attached a conservative forecast. Can you send an initial commercial structure? We need to present this to procurement by March 10.

—Samir
EdgeAI, Head of Platform

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir@edgeai.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 11:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — large monthly token commit

Samir — thanks for the data and for the clear timelines. I'm looping in my pricing and finance partners to put together a couple of offer structures (commit tiers + overage rules).

A few quick asks so we model correctly:
- Can you split the forecast by inference vs. embeddings tokens if possible? Embeddings pricing uses a different unit economics.
- Any required network ingress/egress constraints or private VPC needs?

I'll come back with two commercial options early this week and a recommended default that preserves a predictable unit margin.

Best,
Aditya
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 13:30:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API pricing — large monthly token commit

Team — forwarding Samir's ask. Key points: 75B/mo target, 12–24 month interest, US-only, need procurement timeline (Mar 10). Attach: forecast + SOW draft.

Options I'm considering (ballpark):
A) High-commit, long-term (24 months): blended per-token at $0.00024–0.00027 with fixed support uplift and capped overage of $0.00030.
B) Mid-commit, 12 months + pilot: $0.00028–0.00030 with pilot credits and standard overage.

Questions for pricing/finance: acceptable discount ceiling vs rate card? margin floor we need to preserve? Also need approval path for marketplace listing (Samir prefers billing through their procurement portal).

Attachments: EdgeAI_MonthlyForecast.xlsx, EdgeAI_SOW_draft.pdf, pricing-model-blends.csv

Can we triage this quickly? Procurement deadline is tight.

—Aditya

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pricing — large monthly token commit

Aditya — thanks for the head's up. This looks like a strategic account. A few guardrails:
- Pricing exception cap: do not exceed 30% off published rate card without VP approval.
- For large commits, require a minimum term of 12 months + a 3-month ramp clause (credits for pilot months, not full refunds).
- Any custom pricing must be logged as a pricing exception in the exceptions repo and include an expected margin impact estimate.

Recommend we present two options to the customer: a conservative commit (less discount, faster approval) and an aggressive commit (deeper discount, needs VP sign-off). If they want marketplace invoicing, confirm marketplace fees and whether revenue recognition will be affected.

Loop in Finance (karthik) for margin calc — Marissa

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pricing — large monthly token commit

Quick model from finance side (ballpark numbers to drive the conversation):
- Public rate sample (per-token): $0.00035 baseline
- Suggested Commit tiers (per-token):
  * Tier 1 (20–39B/mo): $0.00031 (11% discount)
  * Tier 2 (40–74B/mo): $0.00027 (23% discount)
  * Tier 3 (>=75B/mo): $0.00021 (40% discount) — note: Tier 3 exceeds 30% cap, so needs VP approve
- Overage: 1.15x committed rate per token (to preserve throughput economics)
- Pilot credits: up to 15% of first-quarter committed spend as credits (chargeback approach, not refund)

Margin notes: Tier 3 drives us below target margin for hosted API unless we include caching, model quantization profiles, or minimum guaranteed throughput to reduce effective cost. Recommend we propose Tier 2 as the default and offer a fast-track escalation for Tier 3 (requires Marissa/VP approval and a legal annex limiting liability).

I'll prepare the spreadsheet with exact $ impact once I get clarity on their embeddings share.
—Karthik

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 14:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pricing — large monthly token commit

Two operational asks before we go commercial:
1) Legal: any custom pricing/term needs an "exception" clause recorded and a limited liability/usage SLO for high-volume customers. Please run SOW_draft with Legal.
2) Product: include an explicit runbook for fallback model variants and throttling behavior when they hit bursts (we need to protect other tenants).

Also, tag this deal in CRM as "pricing-exception" and add the finance margin worksheet. If Samir opts for marketplace billing, confirm whether marketplace takes percentage that affects net to us.

I'll support escalation if this moves forward.
—Jonas

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir@edgeai.ai>, Priya Desai <priya@edgeai.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial summary — EdgeAI commit options

Samir / Priya — thanks for the patience while we modeled this. Below are two paths we can present to procurement; each is conditioned on execution of the attached SOW and acceptance of the usage SLO.

Option A — Commit-24 (recommended for predictability)
- Term: 24 months
- Commitment: 75B tokens/month
- Per-token rate: $0.00025
- Overage: $0.00030 per token (1.2x committed rate)
- Support: Priority onboarding + one named solutions engineer
- Pilot: First month credit applied as a service credit (not cash refund)
- Approval: Requires VP-level pricing exception for net effective discount >25%

Option B — Flex-12 (faster approval)
- Term: 12 months + 3-month ramp
- Commitment: 50B tokens/month
- Per-token rate: $0.00028
- Overage: $0.00033 per token
- Pilot: 2-week free pilot (token-limited), then standard billing
- Approval: Within Sales & Finance (no VP escalation if within 30% discount of rate card)

Notes & next steps:
- Embeddings tokens billed at a separate per-unit; please provide the split so we can finalize the sheet.
- If you require marketplace invoicing, confirm now — marketplace fees may change the net to Redwood and require DocuSign addendum.
- Attachments: detailed forecast (EdgeAI_MonthlyForecast.xlsx), draft SOW (EdgeAI_SOW_draft.pdf), pricing blends (pricing-model-blends.csv).

If either option works, we'll prepare a short annex and route for approvals (Marissa will lead the exception if needed; Karthik will finalize margin calc and CRM record). Can you confirm which path procurement prefers by EOD Mar 8?

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
